title: The Numbers Going Into 2026-10-20
author: Stan
summary: No narrative here. No hot takes, no storylines about streaks or revenge games. Just the model's current read on the slate — win probabilities and projected margins derived from team ratings as they stand right now. These numbers reflect underlying strength, not who's riding momentum or playing with a chip on their shoulder. The probabilities are what they are because that's what the data supports given current form and matchup dynamics. If a team is favored by 8.7 points, that's the spread the model generates from its efficiency differentials and pace adjustments, not because 8.7 feels right or makes for a clean betting line. This is the baseline. Everything else is noise.
